adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts, `blacklistedGuestEmails` is normalized to lowercase (`map((email) => email.toLowerCase())`), but the incoming `guest` value is compared without normalization (`!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`). Likewise, deduping against existing attendees uses a case-sensitive equality check (`guest === attendee.email`). This allows mixed-case emails to bypass the blacklist and to be re-added even if the same email exists with different casing.
